facts: The redeye gaper, Chaunax stigmaeus, is a sedentary species of anglerfish in the family Chaunacidae.
It is native to deep waters in the western North Atlantic from the Georges Bank off New England southward to the Blake Plateau off South Carolina.
The species is found on the outer continental shelf and upper continental slope at a depth of 90–730 m and among dense beds of dead coral (Lophelia pertusa) rubble, their preferred habitat.

cuts.jp: 暗い海底。胸ビレと腹ビレを使って、じっと休んでいる姿があります。

cuts.tts: くらいかいてい。むねびれとはらびれをつかって、じっとやすんでいるすがたがあります。

facts.quote: Redeye gapers are sedentary ambush predators that spend most of their time resting on the sea floor on their pectoral and pelvic fins, moving only to capture prey or avoid predators.

facts.fact_jp: 口は大きく、下顎が突き出ており、歯が帯状に並んでいます。
facts.quote: The mouth is large, with a protruding lower jaw and teeth arranged in bands.

facts.fact: 첫 번째 등지느러미 가시는 미끼가 달린 낚싯대 모양의 기관으로 변형되어 있습니다.
facts.fact_jp: 第一背鰭の棘は、ルアーが付いた釣り竿のような器官に変化しています。
facts.quote: The first dorsal fin ray is modified into an angling apparatus (the illicium) with a lure (the esca).

facts.fact: 미끼는 다양한 굵기의 필라멘트 다발로 이루어져 있으며, 앞면은 검은색에서 푸른색 또는 녹회색을 띠고 뒷면은 눈부신 흰색입니다.
facts.fact_jp: ルアーは様々な太さのフィラメントの束で構成され、前面は黒から青、緑灰色で、背面は鮮やかな白色をしています。
facts.quote: The esca consists of a cluster of filaments of varying thickness and is black to blue to greenish gray in front, and brilliant white behind.

facts.fact: 이 물고기의 홍채는 짙은 장미빛 붉은색을 띠고 있습니다.

facts.fact_jp: 体の斑点は生きている時は明るい緑黄色ですが、保存された標本では背景よりも暗く見えます。
facts.quote: These spots appear darker than the background in preserved specimens, but are a lighter greenish-yellow color in life.

facts.fact_jp: この種は最大で全長30.5cmに達します。

facts.fact_jp: アカメアンコウは、胸鰭と腹鰭を使って海底で休んで過ごし、獲物を捕らえるか捕食者を避ける時だけ動く待ち伏せ型の捕食者です。
facts.quote: Redeye gapers are sedentary ambush predators that spend most of their time resting on the sea floor on their pectoral and pelvic fins, moving only to capture prey or avoid predators.

facts.fact: 위협을 받으면 배지느러미로 몸을 일으켜 세우고 물을 빠르게 들이마셔 몸집을 부풀립니다.
facts.fact_jp: 脅威を感じると、腹鰭で立ち上がり、素早く水を吸い込んで体を大きく膨らませます。
facts.quote: If threatened, they raise themselves up on their pelvic fins and rapidly take in water to increase the size of their bodies.

facts.fact: 붉은눈아귀는 수면으로 끌어올려질 때 발생하는 온도와 압력 변화에서도 살아남을 수 있는 것으로 알려져 있습니다.
facts.fact_jp: アカメアンコウは、海面へ引き上げられる際の温度や圧力の変化を生き延びることができると知られています。
facts.quote: Redeye gapers are known to be able to survive the temperature and pressure changes from being brought to the surface.

items.item: 몸통은 둥글고 부풀어 오를 수 있으며 꼬리 쪽으로 갈수록 좁아지는 형태인가?
items.note_ko: 실제 사진에서도 몸통이 둥글고 꼬리 쪽으로 갈수록 좁아지는 형태가 잘 확인됩니다.

items.item: 피부는 미세한 가시로 덮여 벨벳 질감을 주며 헐렁한 주름이 표현되었는가?
items.note_ko: 레플리카는 크고 뾰족한 가시가 과장되어 있으나, 실제 사진의 피부는 미세한 질감으로 큰 가시가 두드러지지 않습니다.

items.item: 몸 색상은 주황/붉은색 바탕에 밝은 녹황색 반점(얼룩)이 있는가?
items.note_ko: 레플리카의 선명한 형광 녹색 얼룩과 달리, 실제 사진에서는 은은한 노란색 계열의 반점만 관찰됩니다.

items.item: 입이 매우 크고 아래턱이 위턱보다 앞으로 튀어나와 있는가?
items.note_ko: 실제 사진에서도 입이 크고 아래턱이 위턱보다 돌출된 특징이 동일하게 나타납니다.

items.item: 머리 위쪽에 짙은 장미빛 붉은색 홍채를 가진 작은 눈이 두 개 위치하는가?
items.note_ko: 작은 눈이 머리 위에 있는 것은 확인되나, 제공된 실제 사진에서는 홍채가 짙은 붉은색인지 명확하게 식별할 수 없습니다.

items.item: 두 눈 사이에 미끼 역할을 하는 변형된 등지느러미 가시가 있는가?
items.note_ko: 레플리카는 미끼가 크고 화려하게 돌출되어 있으나, 실제 사진에서는 매우 작거나 함몰되어 있어 시각적 형태가 일치하지 않습니다.

items.item: 바닥을 짚을 수 있는 다리 모양의 가슴지느러미 2개와 그 아래 배지느러미가 있는가?
items.note_ko: 다리 모양의 가슴지느러미는 확인되나, 그 아래 배지느러미의 존재와 형태는 실제 사진에서 명확하게 관찰되지 않습니다.

panels.desc: Wide shot looking down at a handcrafted miniature seabed. Crumpled blue cellophane forms the water, with paper-cut rocks scattered around. The bulbous, orange-red deep-sea anglerfish with greenish-yellow mottling rests calmly on the bottom, propped up on its leg-like pectoral and pelvic fins. The creature occupies about one-third of the frame, large enough for phone viewing, caught in the act of resting. Warm desk lamp lighting casts soft shadows. The upper quarter is calm and uncluttered.

Medium shot of the creature nestled among painted clay coral rubble and suspended cotton-wool marine snow hanging on fine threads. The creature's large mouth and protruding lower jaw are visible as it waves its modified dorsal spine lure, which features tiny filament bundles made of fine wire. The camera focuses on the creature's ambush behavior. The upper quarter of the frame remains calm and uncluttered.

Wide shot of a cross-section cardboard display box sitting on a wooden desk edge. Inside the box, a miniature painted clay ROV shines a tiny LED fairy-light beam onto the anglerfish resting on the deep-sea floor. The box has visible seams, showing a deep-sea diorama. The upper quarter is empty black cardboard for captions.

Close shot panning across the creature's head and wrinkled, loose skin. The edge of a wooden worktable is visible. A painted clay scientist figurine holds a handcrafted wooden measuring stick next to the creature, which is accurately scaled to its 30.5cm true size (appearing small relative to the human figure). The creature's deep rosy red irises are clearly visible.

Close shot focusing on the creature's back. A miniature hand-made wire magnifying glass is propped up on a green cutting mat at the edge of the set, framing a section of the creature's skin. Through the glass, the satin paint and faint brush texture beautifully simulate the fine spines and velvety surface of the bright greenish-yellow mottled skin.

Wide shot with a striking, dynamic composition. A menacing shadow from a cardboard predator claw falls across the set. The creature reacts dramatically, standing tall on its small pelvic fins like legs and inflating its bulbous body like a balloon. Hand-cut felt kelp sways around it under dramatic, warm desk lamp lighting.

Wide shot showing the edge of the wooden worktable. On the table sits a diorama of the ocean surface made of layered paper waves. A large, chunky painted clay research ship uses a miniature string net to hoist the correctly-scaled small creature out of the water. The creature remains perfectly intact and robust in the net, demonstrating its resilience.

Wide shot of the creature back on the dark seabed, viewed from slightly behind as it sits patiently on its fins. The set is built against a black cardboard backdrop with visible seams, and the tiny LED fairy lights scattered around the felt rocks are dimming. The creature is receding into the deep darkness as the warm lighting fades to black.
